abstract.para: libpng is the official reference library for supporting the Portable Network Graphics (PNG) image format. It is a fundamental graphical component widely used across desktop environments, image processing utilities and multimedia frameworks in &suselinux;.

topic.para: The libpng package follows the balanced lifecycle model across all &suselinux; 16 products. The update strategy is governed by the following rules:

listitem.para: libpng is categorized under the balanced lifecycle to allow seamless patch-level updates that address security vulnerabilities, bug fixes and performance improvements while safeguarding application compatibility across enterprise installations.

Upstream libpng maintains strict ABI compatibility within active release series. Updates adhere to patch-level version bumps that preserve the same soname, ensuring that downstream applications and graphical libraries do not break or require rebuilds.
For all libpng series that remain active in upstream maintenance, updates to the latest patch version are delivered across all supported &suselinux; 16 codestreams as new versions become available.
